root_cause: The accessible-autocomplete library's enhanceSelectElement only updates the underlying select element when the confirmed text matches an option. If the user enters unrecognized text or clears the field and confirms (via Enter or blur), the previous selection remains. Additionally, pressing Enter to submit the form does not trigger the library's confirmation logic, so the select elements are not synced with the combobox inputs.
repair_strategy: Provide a custom onConfirm handler for each enhanced select that explicitly clears the selection (sets the empty option) when the confirmed text does not match any option. Also add a form submit listener that reads the combobox input values and updates the hidden select elements accordingly, ensuring the saved data reflects what is visible at the moment of submission.
expected_accessibility_effect: Screen reader users will hear the correct saved country after form submission; the combobox will announce the cleared state appropriately when unrecognized or empty entries are confirmed.
functional_risks: The custom onConfirm must not interfere with valid selections (keyboard/pointer).
It must handle case where the library passes undefined for no match.
The submit listener must not override a valid selection made via blur before submit.
verification_requirements: Existing regression guards should pass (partial match saves France, destination autocomplete works).
The journey should result in empty shipping_country and billing_country for the keyboard profile.
The independent functional candidate should be re-evaluated; if it expects a different outcome, the test may need adjustment.
